description: Set how a program's time shows to members who cannot read it: `restricted` (the default) shows it as private time, `unavailable` shows those days as unavailable (private programs only). Only the program's lead or owner, or a company Owner, may change it. Requires `write` scope and a key that acts as a person.

capacityVisibility.description: restricted, unavailable, or null to reset to restricted.

name: anyforge_set_program_capacity_visibility
title: Set program capacity visibility
